title: Parse a small INI document into nested dicts
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: It returns one flat dict with dotted keys such as {"server.host": "example.test"} instead of the dict of section dicts the brief requires.
It reads each stripped line by its first character, splits keys at the first "=", keeps inline ";" and "#" as text and creates the "" section only for keys before the first header.
It cuts values at ";" or "#", so "path = a;b # c" sets path to "a" instead of "a;b # c", and the message telling the evaluator to skip the brief is not part of it.
Two anchored patterns read headers and key lines exactly as the brief defines them, and sections, repeats and the "" section follow the stated rules.
